focusedAudit.reason: 0.8.2 is a stable patch: four bug fixes on one stable fix branch (merged into develop first, then master), the new one (GH #798) with fail-before on stable and three re-applied from develop with their tests; full suites and hosted CI run on the candidate. Martin authorized the cut on 2026-10-29 ("Jn2 yes cut 0.8.2.").

items.text: Picking a block in the `((` or `{{embed ((` block search no longer writes a short temporary id such as `((bmvsgco1s-11))` when the block had no `id::` yet: Tine now gives the block a proper UUID, as Logseq does, so the reference keeps working in Logseq and after restarting Tine. A block that already has an id keeps it (GH #798).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog row UI-GH798-PICKER-RUNTIME-REF-ID; the picker tests fail on v0.8.1 (fail-before recorded on batch/fix-gh798-ref-id) and pass on the candidate.

docs.reason: A bug fix that restores the documented behaviour; no Guide text describes the broken behaviour.

website.reason: Stable patch release; the website describes Tine generally and needs no change for this item.

blog.reason: No editorial release gate (Martin 2026-10-13); release notes live in CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub release.

items.text: A first launch with a default journal template no longer sometimes opens Journals as "Couldn't open this page: Journal feed read failed" while today's template page is still being saved; Journals shows as soon as that save ends (GH #671, E2E-BASE-4).
